principles: Reuse the exported project-level resolver (evaluateStoryDirConfigInsideGitRoot) for the no-story fallback
cwd-only: never change gate pass/fail semantics or git command text
Minimal: only the verifier.ts no-story gitCwd fallback, no repo-wide rework
drivers: The report Bug 1 standalone symptom (bare validate --concept) is still live on wrapper-root
A proven id-independent resolver already exists and is exported
B-2856 left the no-story branch uncovered because its resolveGitCwd needs a storyId

options.name: A: project-level fallback at the verifier.ts no-story branch
pros: Minimal, cwd-only, byte-identical for plain repos
cons: Latent non-gate git sites elsewhere remain (out of scope, not reported)

options.name: B: require --story for the gates
cons: Breaks the documented standalone diagnostic command; worse UX

options.name: C: repo-wide git invocation rework
cons: Overkill, high regression risk, scope creep

chosen: A: project-level fallback at the verifier.ts no-story branch
rationale: Option A changes the no-story gitCwd fallback in verifier.ts from projectRoot to the project-level evaluateStoryDirConfigInsideGitRoot result (falling back to projectRoot when no gitRoot resolves), reusing the exported id-independent resolver. It is cwd-only, byte-identical for plain repos, mirrors the B-2856 pattern, and covers the bare concept/channel/lint gates. B breaks the standalone command; C is overkill.

preMortem.trigger: the resolver returns a non-null gitRoot when none is configured
preMortem.consequence: plain repos run gate git in the wrong dir
preMortem.mitigation: fall back to projectRoot when the resolved gitRoot is null; test that plain-repo gitCwd equals projectRoot

preMortem.scenario: Resolver throws and crashes the validate pipeline
preMortem.mitigation: the resolver is total (top-level try/catch returning a null gitRoot); the projectRoot fallback covers null

preMortem.scenario: Only the concept gate fixed; channel/lint still broken
preMortem.trigger: the no-story fallback is computed per-gate rather than shared
preMortem.consequence: bare channel/lint still fail on wrapper-root
preMortem.mitigation: apply the same project-level fallback to the shared no-story gitCwd in verifier.ts; the test asserts the resolved cwd

preMortem.scenario: Collision with a B-2856 follow-up in verifier.ts
preMortem.trigger: another session edits the same block
preMortem.mitigation: fleet verified done (no in-flight stories); keep the change narrow; merge main before DONE
